## Source and method

- https://github.com/agencyenterprise/react-native-health
- https://github.com/kingstinct/react-native-healthkit
- https://github.com/matinzd/react-native-health-connect
- https://github.com/mley/capacitor-health
- https://github.com/Cap-go/capacitor-health
- https://github.com/perfood/capacitor-healthkit
- https://github.com/dariosalvi78/cordova-plugin-health
- https://github.com/carp-dk/carp-health-flutter
- https://github.com/fam-tung-lam/health_connector
- https://github.com/kvs-coder/health_kit_reporter
- https://github.com/imdzx/flutter_health_connect

For each of 11 React Native, Capacitor, Cordova and Flutter wrappers of HealthKit and Health Connect tracked on this site, the files that map the library's own data-type names onto the platform's (a permission switch, a type dictionary, a TypeScript union of identifier strings, an import list; named per library in the library's page) were read from raw.githubusercontent.com on 2026-11-19, at the commit of the release tag that names the registry's latest version, or at the default branch head where no tag does (refKind). Every HealthKit identifier (HKQuantityTypeIdentifier, HKCategoryTypeIdentifier, HKCharacteristicTypeIdentifier or HKCorrelationTypeIdentifier, as an Objective-C constant, a string or a Swift case) and every Health Connect record class those files name outside a comment is one row, with the file, line and verbatim line. match is exact when the token is, character for character, an identifier in this site's HealthKit identifier dataset or a class in its Health Connect records dataset, and unmatched otherwise (correlation types, which those datasets do not cover, and types newer than them); nothing is matched by similarity. A row says the library's mapping files name the type; it is not a test of the call at runtime. Left out: expo-health-connect (An Expo config plugin for react-native-health-connect: it edits the Android project and maps no data type itself, so its coverage is react-native-health-connect's.); react-native-google-fit (Wraps the Google Fit APIs, neither HealthKit nor Health Connect (libraries.ts records its registry description as naming Google Fit only).).

A null means the source does not state the value or it could not be verified. It never means zero, and it is never a guess. In the CSV a null is an empty unquoted field.

## Update cadence

- `src/data/healthLibrarySupport.ts` is generated by `scripts/fetch-health-library-support.mjs` from the sources above, last read 2026-11-19.
- No workflow runs that script: it is run by hand when the sources are re-read.
- The files are rebuilt by `npm run datasets` (scripts/build-datasets.mjs); a run with no source change writes byte-identical files. The edition stays 2026.1, and a new edition ships under a new file name rather than overwriting this one.
